main.description: A group role and its group-wide grants, in the members space, keyed by role ID, of 64 characters at most. Grants within a space live in that space's policy. A role is deleted only once no member holds it.

default.description: Granted to members who join through requestJoin. With no role marked so, a newcomer gets member.

bot.description: People with this role are bots: accounts that act on their own, not a person. A member is a bot if any of their roles says so.

scopes.description: Group-wide OAuth scopes, one per item. For scopes not tied to one space, such as manage=create, rpc: scopes, and space:* grants.

assignable.description: Keys of roles this role may assign, or * for every role.
